scope: One exact 258-residue RA95.5-8F parent; one protein-only Chai invocation; all five correlated native outputs. No ligand, template, motif coordinates, restraints, trimming, tuning or resampling.
shared_asset_identity: Pinned container, conformer and seven-file ESM payload hashes match the preceding design run. All five new 384 exports were frozen and rehashed before prediction; they are not the earlier 256 export bytes.

preflight_failure.reason: Expected sequence hash literal omitted two characters. The actual FASTA file hash matched the frozen input.
preflight_failure.correction: Corrected only the expected hash literal; preserved the failed preflight logs, original script and launch receipt.

compute_guard.kind: Separate Prime CPU sandbox running an API termination watchdog; independent of this interactive session. This is not a native GPU expiry setting.
compute_guard.target: Exact unique run name, then adopted pod ID; refuses ambiguous or changed identity.
compute_guard.termination_reason: Interactive cleanup after local bundle verification, before watchdog deadline.

billing_observation.source: Prime web UI, Instances > History; matching provider/GPU and creation/termination timestamps; Sandboxes > History matched watchdog name and timestamps.

interpretation: Descriptive parent-control geometry only. Good global fold with appreciable local motif deviations weakens catalytic interpretation of motif loss in the design arm. No activity measurement, calibration, fresh-generalization or Atlas-benefit claim.
